Thanks again for taking time yesterday. Quick recap from our side and a short list of items Procurement asked for so you can see what we still need to get Acme fully set up:

- Missing items we flagged: completed vendor packet, signed W-9 or W-8 (depending on tax status), and routing/banking details for ACH.
- Purchasing preference you mentioned: PO-first (preferred) — marketplace enrollment is currently not an option for your org. Confirmed?
- Timing: once we receive vendor packet + W-9 + bank info, Finance can generate an invoice and accept a PO. Typical vendor activation is 7–10 business days after receipt of fully completed paperwork.

I've looped in Ben (Finance) and Rishi (Billing) — they can confirm the exact fields we need in the vendor packet and whether W-8 is required if Acme's entity is non-US.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send our vendor packet (fillable PDF) and a prefilled W-9 for signature — please route to your procurement mailbox.
2) Samantha/Jared, confirm that PO is the working purchase path and whether a marketplace listing is required now or future.
3) Ben/Rishi will confirm banking detail requirements and provide sample invoice/PO text to include.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (fillable), Redwood_W9_Fillable.pdf.

If it helps I can book a 30-min procurement touchpoint tomorrow morning to walk through the packet fields with your team.

Thanks,

Thanks Diego / Samantha — looping in a couple of clarifications from Finance so Acme can prepare the packet without delays.

Ben here (Finance). A few items to call out:
- Vendor packet: make sure the packet includes a field for EIN/TIN, remit-to address, payment terms (Net30, Net45), and a primary AP contact. Also add a checkbox for ACH enrollment and a line for the bank name and routing/account number.
- W-9: digital signed PDF is acceptable for our onboarding; we do not require an original wet signature for standard vendor activation. Scan is fine.
- Bank verification: bank letter is preferred but not mandatory if the routing/account numbers are provided AND the bank name matches. For international vendors we'd need SWIFT/IBAN.
- PO flow: once vendor is activated in our system, we can send a PO referencing an ACME internal number. We generally require vendor packet + W-9 before activation.

I attached a short banking instructions text and prefilled vendor packet from our side; Diego, can you send the completed packet back when Acme fills it and we’ll start onboarding?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
